title: Beyond accuracy: what AI assurance needs to establish in public services
abstract: arXiv:2611.06655v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Public bodies increasingly rely on AI-produced evidence, including classifications, summaries and assessments. These outputs can inform policy decisions and service delivery, making their reliability a matter of public accountability. Establishing whether this evidence can be relied upon requires testing its outputs and examining how organisations decide whether those tests are sufficient. We combine technical evaluation with analysis of AI governance requirements, informed by measurement theory and management-based regulation. We compare eight GPT-4o configurations classifying 1,200 UK Prime Minister's Questions into 21 policy topics, against human-coded labels and across unchanged repeats. Accuracy ranges from 68.2% to 70.3%, yet 24.3% of questions receive different labels, with changes in topic shares and rankings. translated_title: 超越准确性：公共服务中AI保障需要确立的内容
translated_abstract: 公共机构越来越依赖AI产生的证据，包括分类、摘要和评估。这些输出可以为政策决策和公共服务提供依据，使其可靠性成为公共问责的重要问题。要确定这些证据是否可以信赖，需要测试其输出结果，并审查组织如何判断这些测试是否足够充分。我们结合技术评估与AI治理要求分析，并借鉴测量理论和管理型监管理论。我们比较了八个GPT-4o配置将1,200条英国首相质询问题分类到21个政策主题的表现，与人工编码标签进行对比，并在相同输入的重复测试中进行检验。各配置的准确率介于68.2%到70.3%之间，然而24.3%的问题获得了不同的标签，各主题的份额和排名也随之变化。各配置之间的一致性高于其与人工编码的一致性：一致性并不能保证正确性。
tldr: 本文通过GPT-4o对英国首相质询进行政策主题分类的实验发现，准确率相近的不同AI配置会产生显著不同的输出结果，且AI之间的一致性不能保证正确性，因此公共服务中的AI保障不能仅依赖准确率指标，还需要建立更全面的可靠性与问责评估机制。
en_tdlr: Through GPT-4o experiments classifying UK Prime Minister's Questions, this paper shows that configurations with similar accuracy scores can produce substantially different outputs and AI-AI agreement does not guarantee correctness, arguing that AI assurance in public services must go beyond accuracy metrics.
